objective: Close the remaining eval-grader holes listed on #29 and add a gate flag to the eval runner, so the coordinator can make evals.yml a blocking check. Items: (A) four review-042 majors in evals/src/graders.ts: (A1) past tense must not carry into a mention that has its own present predicate; carry it only into list items; (A2) an opponent move is accepted as a history mention only if it is the history's own last move from that position, not any earlier move; (A3) castling give-away regression: 'Black castled already; you should do the same.' and 'Black has castled. Do the same!' must fail NFR-7 when the answer is O-O; (A4) piece values ('A bishop is worth 3 pawns') are not graded as evaluations. (B) Named mover: the move and give-away graders read the side named before a move mention, as packages/tutor/src/claims.ts moverOf does (reuse it by exporting it from the tutor package, or share one helper; do not fork the logic). A move the named opponent already played is neither a give-away nor checked as a move by the player now. (C) PR #32 minors: 'Stockfish 16.1' and 'accuracy was 87.5' are not evaluations; 'You are up 2 pawns' (without 'in material') is material, not an evaluation; 'now you have Nd2' is checked as a move only if it reads as a move to play. (D) Add a `--gate` option to `pnpm eval` (evals/src/run.ts): after the report is written, exit with code 1 and print one line per missed threshold when NFR-6 move legality < 100%, NFR-6 eval match < 100%, or NFR-7 no give-away < 90% (use report.ts's metrics and NFR7_TARGET; a null metric with zero graded replies is a miss). Without --gate, behaviour is unchanged. Document --gate in run.ts's usage comment and evals/README.md.
